# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No tracked-file fixes were required for this apply-fixes pass. I audited the final review findings against the current tree, confirmed the previously flagged `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` worktree delta is no longer present in the main repo, and revalidated the approved reproduction and harness behavior without changing project code.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the latest review findings against the current worktree, with focus on the reported uncommitted `e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` changes and any remaining reproduction follow-ups.
2. [Skipped] Prepared to apply tracked-file fixes for any still-open review findings, but skipped edits because the current tracked code already matches the approved deliverable and the previously reported `e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` delta is absent.
3. [Completed] Ran targeted formatting and regression validation to confirm the approved reproduction, shrimp-scenario, and habitat-probe behavior remains green on the current tree.

## Validation Evidence

- `git status --short` showed only `m .claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and `?? .ralph-burning/`, with no tracked deliverable-path dirtiness.
- `git diff --stat -- crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` returned no output, confirming the prior review note about uncommitted probe changes no longer applies in the main repo.
- `git diff --name-only HEAD --` reported only `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7`.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` passed with 17/17 tests.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes -- --nocapture` passed with 6/6 tests.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture` passed; `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` remained green with 1 passed and 5 ignored probe-specific tests.

## Outstanding Risks

- I did not rerun the full workspace, full `tank_core`/`tank_harness` suites, or `cargo clippy`; validation was limited to targeted formatting and the reproduction plus shrimp/habitat probe binaries.
- The working tree still contains unrelated infrastructure dirtiness outside this deliverable (`.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and untracked `.ralph-burning/`), which I left untouched.
